The Meeting of Board of Directors was held today on 03rd November, 2026, to consider Unaudited Financial Result for the quarter ended on 30th September, 2026.
Kindly take note of the same.

The Meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company was held today i.e. on 03rd  day of November, 2026, at the Registered Office of the Company, which was commenced at 11.00 A.M. and concluded at  12:00  P.M., inter alia, to consider and take on record the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company
